title: Bell-Deafened
origin: A command bell burst inside the skull and left every order sounding distant.
burdenText: You cannot receive assistance on Command tests.
adaptationText: Once per round, after every requested helper declines, add +1 Command.
text: Warbell pressure punched a permanent silence through one side of your skull.
flavor: You hear bells best when no one else can.
trigger: Your first command check against a threat each session.
penalty: Gain a bell-note before rolling unless another player spends a note to steady you.

effect.text: Bell-Deafened scar recorded a warbell warning.

relief: A follower with the guide or informant role may exhaust to cancel this trigger.
upside: If the command check succeeds, gain a note naming the threat's tell.
